newsitem.title: SPAIN: Futures lift desultory Madrid stocks at close.
newsitem.headline: Futures lift desultory Madrid stocks at close.

text.p: MADRID, Sept 30 (Reuter) 1515 GMT - Madrid stocks rebounded in late trade, lifted by active futures trading and end of the trading period manuevres.

Dealers said the upward tendency would be short term at best, because the market was at resistence levels. * General index up 1.82 points, 0.50 percent, at 368.27 * Ibex-35 gained 20.51 points, 0.49 percent, to 4,215.57 * Telefonica rose 15 pesetas to 2,385 with 3.7 million shares traded
